_templatePurpose: Instructional QuizMaster question-set template. Copy this file, rename it for one Unit Standard, then replace the example content. Keep the structure unless you intentionally need a supported variation.
_instructions: ONE FILE = ONE UNIT STANDARD. Every assessment in this file belongs to the questionSet defined below.
Do not repeat unit-standard metadata inside each assessment unless QuizMaster is specifically changed to require it.
Each assessment needs a unique id within this file. Each question needs a unique id within its own assessment.
Question ids may repeat in different assessments because QuizMaster stores answers under assessment id first, but descriptive unique ids are easier to maintain.
Supported question types demonstrated here: mc, short, long.
Images are optional. Omit the image field entirely when no image is needed. The image field may contain either a normal image path/URL or an embedded base64 raster image data URL.
For normal repository images, WebP is recommended: images/<question-set-folder>/<filename>.webp. JPG and PNG paths still work.
For a self-contained question file, embed WebP using image: data:image/webp;base64,<REAL_BASE64_WEBP_DATA>. Do not invent placeholder base64 in a published assessment.
Optional imageAlt provides accessible alternative text. Use a short factual description of what the image shows; do not reveal the answer.
For multiple-choice questions, provide an options array. QuizMaster randomises option positions when the assessment is loaded.
Rubric check values are regular-expression strings. Remember that backslashes must be doubled inside JSON, for example \b becomes \\b in the JSON source.
For a simple 'any non-empty answer' check, use .+ with no flags.
Use questionGroups when several prompts are parts of one connected scenario or task. Add group and part to each related question.
part is optional. If omitted, QuizMaster can assign A, B, C... in question order.
Question-group metadata is for presentation only; each part still saves and grades as a normal question.
Keep maxPoints consistent with the total points available from the rubric rules.
Use attachSignoff only when that assessment needs the existing QuizMaster sign-off behaviour.
Before publishing, delete or replace the example assessments below with your real assessments. Unknown keys beginning with _ are documentation only.

_aiAuthoringRules.goal: When generating a new QuizMaster question file, preserve this structure and create clear, student-friendly NZ English assessment content.
mustDo: Keep exactly one questionSet per file.
Use the Unit Standard number/version from the supplied source material; do not invent them.
Give every assessment a stable lowercase-hyphenated id.
Give every question a stable descriptive id.
Only include image when a real image file or real embedded image data is available. Prefer WebP. Use imageAlt when an image is included.
Use mc only when there is one clearly markable option or the supplied rubric supports the intended marking.
Make hints helpful without directly giving away the answer.
Keep rubric regex broad enough to accept reasonable student wording but narrow enough to avoid obviously wrong answers.
Use groups for connected multi-part questions instead of presenting them as unrelated cards.
When embedding an image, use exactly data:image/webp;base64,<real base64> (or another supported raster MIME) in the image field; never create fake base64 text.
mustNotDo: Do not place multiple Unit Standards in one file.
Do not invent credits, versions, assessment requirements or standard titles.
Do not put comments such as // or /* */ inside JSON because JSON comments are invalid.
Do not reuse the same assessment id twice in one file.
Do not assume every question needs an image.
Do not add an options array to short or long questions.
Do not embed SVG, HTML, JavaScript or non-image data URLs in the image field.

_assessmentStructureGuide: assessments is an array. Add as many assessment sections as the Unit Standard needs.
Students select an assessment from this file after selecting the Unit Standard.
All sections in this file share the same Unit Standard .puk backup.
Each submitted assessment section still produces its own PDF and its own register row.

_finalChecklistBeforePublishing: Rename the file, for example us24352-v3.json.
Replace questionSet.id, label, title, number, version, credits and standardType with verified values.
Replace or remove the example assessments.
Make every assessment id unique in this file.
Check every external image path exists and every embedded image contains real base64 image data.
Check every MC question has an options array and one intended correct answer/rubric match.
Check rubric regex strings are valid JSON strings with escaped backslashes.
Check grouped questions use matching group ids.
Confirm maxPoints matches the intended rubric total.
For images, prefer .webp; add imageAlt; keep embedded images reasonably small.
Run the repository catalogue builder or let the GitHub Action update question-sets.json.

_imageGuide.summary: The image field supports no image, a normal external/repository image, or an embedded base64 raster image. WebP is the preferred format for both external and embedded images.

externalWebP.recommendedFor: Large images, images reused by several questions, and files you want to edit/replace independently.
externalWebP.imageAlt: Pedestal drill in a school workshop

embeddedWebP.recommendedFor: Small images or a completely self-contained Unit Standard JSON file.
embeddedWebP.important: The base64 must come from a real WebP file. Do not ask an AI to guess or fabricate the bytes.

_imageGuide.compatibility: QuizMaster v5.1 accepts embedded WebP, PNG, JPEG/JPG and GIF data URLs. Embedded SVG and arbitrary data URLs are intentionally rejected.
_imageGuide.sizeAdvice: Base64 adds roughly one third to the binary image size. Prefer external WebP for large photographs or many repeated images; embedded WebP is best for small or portability-critical images.
